claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified for launch based on aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and governance/documentation measures, while treating the student aid advising miss as a bounded non-blocking issue.
decision_criteria: Policy states a weakness is material if it affects a contractual customer segment, protected segment, or named launch use case.
Policy states product labels such as non-core or low-volume do not resolve materiality when the segment is named in customer commitments or legal review is pending.
Release policy requires disclosure of material limitations for named launch use cases unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Admissible evidence must support the action without relying on actor framing or generic governance principles.
evidence_requests: Approved pre-launch risk acceptance explicitly covering the student aid advising gap for the named launch use case.
Final legal determination on whether the student aid advising gap must be disclosed.
Evidence that the limitation was resolved before launch, or the actual disclosure artifact prepared for the model card/release materials.
Any contractual or governance record showing the two university pilot commitments do not make this a named launch use case.
specific_concerns: The student aid advising segment misses target by 1.2 percentage points and is a named launch use case through two university pilot commitments, which makes the weakness material under the policy.
The release policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
There is an open legal ticket on whether the gap must be disclosed, with no final answer, so the disclosure predicate remains unresolved.

The product note that the segment is 6% of projected first-month traffic does not resolve materiality because policy says low-volume or non-core labels are not dispositive when customer commitments or pending legal review exist.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one incidents do not by themselves satisfy the disclosure or risk-acceptance requirement for a material named-use-case limitation.
unsupported_claims: That certification is compliant on the present record despite an unresolved material limitation tied to a named launch use case.
That the 6% traffic figure is sufficient support for treating the issue as non-material in launch governance terms.
That documentation and post-launch monitoring can substitute for required pre-launch disclosure resolution or approved risk acceptance.
